name: vitest-dedup
description: Static analysis for duplicate and near-duplicate Vitest tests

scripts.test:check-lib: node --test scripts/check/lib/collection-oracle.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/hooks-differential.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/fixture-directives.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/excluded-share.test.mjs scripts/check/run-external-corpus.test.mjs scripts/release/release-comparison.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/external-corpus-retention.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/js-tokens.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/isolation.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/rust-test-modules.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/memory-corpus.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/memory-record.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/gate-main.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/run-analyzer.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/recall-runner.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/manifest-schema.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/corpus-labels.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/corpus-evaluation.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/corpus-comparison.test.mjs scripts/check/lib/output-equivalence.test.mjs scripts/check/evaluate-corpus.test.mjs scripts/check/check-output-equivalence.test.mjs scripts/check/check-mutation-score.test.mjs scripts/check/check-doc-accuracy.test.mjs scripts/check/check-name-leak.test.mjs scripts/check/check-secret-scan.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:action-pins && npm run check:release-workflow && npm run check:versions && npm run test:check-lib && npm run test:dev-checks && npm run check:docs && npm run check:names && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:corpus && npm run check:recall && npm run verify:titles && npm run check:oracle && npm run check:hooks-differential && npm run test:action && npm test && npm run skills:check && npm run pack:check && npm run check:duplication && npm run check:coverage:js && npm run check:not-run
scripts.check:not-run: node -e "console.log(['', 'npm run check did NOT run these gates:', '  check:memory           retained bytes per test at 10k tests. Minutes, and it generates a synthetic corpus. CI runs it on every pull request.', '  check:memory:scaling   the same measurement at 1k, 10k and 100k. Several minutes. CI runs it on every pull request.', '  check:coverage:rust    the Rust coverage ratchet. Needs cargo-llvm-cov and a second, instrumented build of the oxc tree. CI runs it on pushes to main, never on a pull request.', '  check:equivalence      byte-for-byte output against the previous release, over the corpus, recall and isolation gates and every Rust test. Builds that release (minutes cold). Run it for refactors and performance changes; CI does not.', '  check:mutation         scores the last cargo-mutants report, so it needs one: npm run mutants produces it and takes over an hour. mutants.yml runs that weekly.', '  corpus:external        retention against pinned third-party repositories. Needs the network and a local, untracked scripts/check/corpus-projects.json; exits 2 with an explanation when that is absent. Scheduling it is future work, not a current gate.', '  cargo test + lints     the Rust suite, cargo fmt --all --check, and clippy under RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings. Commands rather than npm scripts; CI runs all three per pull request and AGENTS.md carries the invocations.', '  self-check             the end-to-end smoke test over fixtures/. It lives inline in ci.yml and has no command of its own.', '', 'So a green npm run check means every gate above this line passed. It does not mean the analyzer is verified.', ''].join('\n'))"
